about.heading: Building around Berkhamsted and the Chilterns since 2019
about.intro: Crown Construction (Home Counties) Ltd was founded in Cheddington, near Leighton Buzzard, in 2019. What started as a small team of joiners and bricklayers has grown into a full building contractor working extensions, renovations and new builds across Berkhamsted, Northchurch, Cheddington, Pitstone and the surrounding villages — without ever losing the habits that got us the first job: turning up on time, quoting honestly, and finishing what we start.
story: We still run every project with our own core trades rather than handing it off to whoever is free that month. The estimator who visits your home is usually the same person who manages the build.
Most of our work now comes from recommendations and repeat clients — people who used us for an extension and came back years later for a loft conversion or a full renovation.

values.title: Honesty in the quote
values.description: If something will cost more once we open up the walls, you hear about it immediately — not on the final invoice.

values.title: Respect for the site
values.description: Your home is a building site for us, but it's still your home. We keep it as tidy and quiet as the job allows.

values.title: Building control, done properly
values.description: Every structural job is designed and signed off correctly — no shortcuts that come back to haunt a future sale.

contact.heading: Tell us about your project
contact.lede: Send a few details about the work you're planning and we'll come back to you within one working day to arrange a site visit and a written quote.
